rows.grounds: compound of mūrti (image) and homa (fire-oblation), accusative object
compound indicating a duration of twenty-one days
fused form containing optative causative of kṛ with particles ca and eva
compound of bhukti (enjoyment) and yuj (joined), qualifying the ritual result

items.question: What duration and intended benefit govern the performance of the image-oblation?
premises: The image-oblation is the ritual act to be performed.
The prescribed duration for this performance is three weeks.
The performance is characterized as endowed with enjoyment.
items.inference: Therefore the image-oblation should be caused to be performed for three weeks for the sake of enjoyment.
items.plain_english: One should have the image-oblation performed for three weeks, accompanied by enjoyment.
